'''Keffis''' were quadruped mounts native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. Like most riding beasts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], most Keffis were selectively bred for intelligence, speed, color, size, and many other characteristics deemed useful by the [[Anaxsi]] nobles.
